_readme: Every sprite in this game is DRAWN IN CODE by js/assets.js, and that
stays the floor: the game must boot with no image files at all.
A file listed here OVERRIDES the generated sprite of the same name;
anything not listed keeps the one the code draws. Art can therefore
arrive one icon at a time.
1. drop art/<name>.png  (<name> is the sprite name, e.g. icon_medbay)
2. add "<name>" to the sprites list below
Leave the list empty and the game looks exactly as it does today.
A name listed with no file behind it is not an error either — the
Sprite names in use: ship_player ship_enemy ship_boss crew_player
ui_panels bg_stars bg_moon shield_ring bar_sprites elevator
